subject: Problems with feeding renderUI input (through uiOutput) into renderGvis object

messages.author: b038a7ce8d6c5637
messages.subject: Problems with feeding renderUI input (through uiOutput) into renderGvis object
parts:
Hi guys,

I've posted a reproducible example on stack overflow but can't seem to get an answer, yet it continues to press on my brain: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/27686604/dynamic-ui-with-googlevis-plot-in-shiny. I can get the plot to work fine by using renderPlot (with R's built-in functions) or by using a ggvis. I can also get it to work for renderGvis with a gvis object if the slider input is not coming from a renderUI function, but is static (by replacing uiOutput in the example with a sliderInput). I figure this is due to some internal conflict with renderGvis producing an html based output similar to renderUI, however I do not know how. Any assistance or ideas would be most welcome.  Thanks!

Ryan
